103/1034.description: Used to reroll the attributes of an Awakened Artifact. As all things shift and the world changes, the road ahead always welcomes a fresh start.

103/1035.name: Fate Lock
103/1035.description: Locks one attribute when rerolling an Awakened Artifact's attributes. A law set millennia ago, unyielding, unbroken, and unmoved by the rise and fall of worlds.

103/1200.name: Artifact Enhancement Stone
103/1200.description: Used to enhance Awakened Artifact. Each enhancement attempt has a chance to fail. On failure, the affected attribute's level -1. Through countless trials, true power emerges.
